objective: Test whether 1H MNQ bars contain stable chronology-OOS information about future adverse excursion and realized volatility even though direct 1H direction classification failed.

targets.long_mae_z: maximum adverse excursion for a hypothetical long over the next horizon, normalized by current close * rv120 * sqrt(horizon)
targets.short_mae_z: maximum adverse excursion for a hypothetical short over the next horizon, normalized by current close * rv120 * sqrt(horizon)
targets.future_rv_z: realized standard deviation of forward 1H log returns over the horizon divided by current rv120

features: Causal 1H-only state features: lagged returns, realized volatility, range/body, volume z-scores, EMA distances, momentum, time-of-day and day-of-week. No NQ inputs and no future-aligned features.

models.mae: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=quantile, quantile=0.80, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=180, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=42)
models.future_rv: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=squared_error, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=180, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=42)

chronology: Quarterly expanding walk-forward from 2022 through 2025 with full-horizon purge between train and test. No random split, no OOS tuning, no target/feature/horizon selection after outcomes.

evaluation.cohort_test: Within each OOS quarter, assign predicted-risk quintiles using cutpoints learned only from the prior training predictions. Compare realized Q5 vs Q1 and monotonic quintile ordering.
evaluation.required_support: Report every eligible chronological quarter. Do not average away quarter failures.
evaluation.advance_rule_mae: A side/horizon is promising only if OOS Spearman is positive in at least 10 of 12+ quarters, median Spearman >= 0.15, and realized Q5 MAE > Q1 MAE in at least 10 of 12+ quarters. Full monotonicity is diagnostic but reported.
evaluation.advance_rule_rv: Future-RV is promising only if OOS Spearman is positive in at least 10 of 12+ quarters and median Spearman >= 0.20.

interpretation: Passing establishes a slow risk/state context candidate only. It does not authorize a gate, sizing rule, entry model, DCA rule, capital routing, or live trading. Any economic consumer must be separately precommitted before its outcomes are inspected.
nq_boundary: NQ is excluded from model inputs and threshold fitting. NQ may later be used only as independent/pre-MNQ historical validation after an MNQ risk hypothesis passes.
